jobs.description:
Office & Studio Operations Manager

Ironhorse Physical Therapy & Pilates | San Ramon, CA | On-site, full-time | Start date: as soon as possible

About the role

Ironhorse is a cash-pay physical therapy and Pilates practice in San Ramon. We are hiring a manager who owns how the practice runs day to day, so the owner can step out of operations. This is not a front-desk seat and not an admin seat. You will own a defined set of outcomes, track them with simple numbers, and fix the cause when something keeps dropping. You may come from boutique fitness, a Pilates or PT studio, a small healthcare practice, or another appointment-based service business. What matters is that you have owned results, led people and followed through.

What you will own

Five areas, each with you as the owner and a weekly number.

- Lead-to-booked-visit and client follow-through: every new inquiry answered fast and moved to a booked visit, no-show and late-cancel follow-up on every one, package renewals and reactivation, client questions and routine issues handled before they reach the owner.

- Scheduling and admin coordination: schedule accuracy and fill in Jane, client messages in Quo, check-in and check-out, the shared admin inbox answered and routed, unpaid balances and superbill paperwork chased to done.

- Owner and Pilates lead coordination: you keep the owner and the lead Pilates instructor aligned and unblocked. That means calendars and handoffs, follow-ups on open items from each of them, a weekly priorities list, and bringing decisions to them in writing so they are not chasing details.

- Staff and intern oversight: you supervise our interns and aides day to day, including schedules, training, task assignments, and timesheets. You also coordinate admin support and front-of-house team members, payroll prep for the twice-monthly run, new-hire paperwork and onboarding checklists. You raise performance issues with the owner with a recommendation.

- Systems: supplies, equipment and vendor or building issues resolved, and written SOPs kept current. You write them and you update them.

KPIs (starting targets, set with you in the first 30 days)

- Admin inbox and Quo messages answered within one business day.

- New-inquiry-to-booked-visit rate tracked weekly, with a follow-up on every lead that does not book.

- No-show and late-cancel rate tracked weekly, with a follow-up on every one.

- Timesheets complete and payroll data ready by the deadline every pay period.

- Intern and aide schedules filled and training checklists complete.

- Open client balances reviewed weekly, with a short written report.

- Every recurring task has a written SOP and a named owner.

- A one-page weekly update to the owner: what moved, what slipped, why, and the fix.

Your first 90 days

- Days 1-30: take over lead-to-booked-visit and client follow-through, and start the weekly priorities list for the owner and the lead Pilates instructor.

- Days 31-60: add scheduling and admin coverage, take over intern and aide oversight, and make routine scheduling reliable.

- Days 61-90: put the weekly scorecard and SOP upkeep in place, and show that fewer routine issues need the owner.

How the role works

Reports to Victoria Liu, owner. Works alongside Joyce (assistant/admin), the lead Pilates instructor, and the clinical team, with a weekly 30-minute review with the owner. You decide on routine scheduling, intern and aide assignments, client issues within agreed limits, supplies and admin process. Clinical decisions stay with clinicians. Hiring, firing, pay, pricing and major spending stay with the owner. Tools: Jane App, Quo, Slack, Google Workspace, QuickBooks (view and reconcile support), ADP (payroll data entry). Full-time, on-site in San Ramon. Practice hours run until 7pm, so some evening coverage is part of the schedule. Exact days to be agreed.

What we are looking for

- 2+ years leading a team or running an office, practice or studio, ideally in healthcare, fitness or another appointment-based business.

- Experience supervising or training junior staff, interns or students.

- A record of improving follow-through, retention or team reliability that you can describe with numbers.

- Strong client communication, and comfort with scheduling/EMR or CRM software (Jane App a plus) and basic billing.

- Calm, clear and organized. You close loops without being chased, and you know when to decide and when to ask.

- Comfortable with confidentiality: patient information (HIPAA) and staff pay.

- Preferred: experience writing SOPs or tracking KPIs. Pilates certification is not required.

Compensation and benefits

$60,000 per year, W-2, full-time.

- Medical stipend: $400 per month

- 401(k) with employer match up to 6%

- Profit sharing eligibility

How to apply

Email admin@ironhorsept.com with the subject "Office & Studio Operations Manager". Include your resume, your availability, and one example of a process you owned end to end and what improved. We would like to fill this role as soon as possible.

Ironhorse PT is an equal opportunity employer.

Pay: $60,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching

jobs.description:
**About Us**

Blue Streak Lighting & Electric is a professional electrical contractor specializing in lighting maintenance, electrical repairs, and LED upgrades for commercial and HOA properties. We are known for responsive service, clear communication, and dependable follow-through.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking an organized, proactive **Account & Project Manager** to oversee customer accounts, coordinate service work and projects, and provide day-to-day direction and support to our field technicians.

You will be the primary point of contact for assigned customers, taking ownership of their requests and keeping work moving from initial inquiry through completion. This includes understanding customer needs, establishing next steps, coordinating schedules and resources, monitoring technician progress, and making sure outstanding items are resolved.

This is a hands-on, office-based role in a busy service environment. You should be comfortable managing multiple accounts and active jobs, communicating directly with property managers, and holding technicians accountable for clear updates, complete documentation, and follow-through.

The ideal candidate builds strong customer relationships, makes sound decisions, and stays involved until the work is complete. You can give clear direction, address issues professionally, and recognize when a situation needs additional technical or management support.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Account Management & Customer Relationships**

* Serve as the primary contact for assigned commercial and HOA accounts
* Build relationships with property managers, board members, and other customer contacts
* Understand each account’s service requirements, priorities, access procedures, and communication preferences
* Take ownership of incoming requests and establish clear next steps
* Keep customers informed about scheduling, job progress, delays, and outstanding decisions
* Follow up on estimates, approvals, and unresolved service needs
* Address customer concerns and coordinate timely resolutions

**Service & Project Management**

* Manage service requests and projects from intake and approval through completion and preparation for invoicing
* Review job scopes, technician notes, estimates, and customer instructions to ensure the team understands the work
* Coordinate technicians, materials, equipment, site access, and scheduling with the office team
* Track active jobs, deadlines, pending materials, return visits, and customer approvals
* Identify obstacles early and take action to keep work moving
* Monitor job progress against the approved scope, budget, and schedule, and flag changes requiring review or authorization
* Confirm completed work is properly documented and outstanding items have been addressed

**Technician Oversight & Support**

* Provide technicians with clear job priorities, instructions, and customer expectations
* Match assignments to technician skills, experience, and job requirements
* Stay in contact with technicians throughout the day to monitor progress and resolve questions about access, materials, or scope
* Follow up on incomplete work, return visits, and missing job information
* Review technician notes and completion photos for accuracy and completeness
* Reinforce expectations for communication, documentation, professionalism, and follow-through
* Bring technical questions, quality concerns, and performance issues to the appropriate manager

**Organization & Team Coordination**

* Manage a high volume of emails, calls, and active tasks while maintaining accurate records
* Keep work orders, account information, schedules, and job notes current in our service management system
* Coordinate with scheduling, estimating, accounting, and management to meet customer commitments
* Ensure requests have a clear owner, next step, and follow-up date
* Help improve workflows and maintain consistent service across assigned accounts

**Qualifications**

* Experience in account management, project coordination, service management, or a similar role involving customer ownership and team coordination
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple jobs and competing priorities
* Clear, professional verbal and written communication
* Confidence directing field staff, following up on commitments, and addressing issues professionally
* Strong computer skills, including Google Docs, Sheets, and Drive, and the ability to learn service management software
* Comfort reviewing estimates, job costs, labor hours, and basic spreadsheets
* Sound judgment, attention to detail, and dependable follow-through
* Ability to learn our services, ask useful questions, and recognize when technical support is needed
* Experience with electrical, lighting, construction, property management, or another field service business is preferred
* Experience with simPRO or similar service management software is a plus

**Schedule & Location**

* Full-time | Monday–Friday | 8-hour shift
* In person at our Santa Clara office

**Compensation & Benefits**

* $30–$34 per hour, based on experience
* Health insurance
* Dental insurance
* Paid time off

**How to Apply**

Please submit your current resume and a brief introduction describing your experience managing customer accounts, coordinating projects, or overseeing field teams.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $33.00 - $35.00 per hour

Expected hours: 38.0 – 44.0 per week

* Dental insurance

* Vision insurance

**About Us:**

Future is building a personalized guidance system for lifelong health. We help people understand what to do next for their body, goals, and stage of life — then support them in turning those decisions into sustained behavior change. By combining AI, human expertise, personal health data, and accountability, Future helps members improve performance today while building the resilience, capacity, and healthspan they need for decades to come.

**Who We Are**
--------------

Future pairs each member with an expert coach who gets to know them, their goals, and their data, then builds a healthier life around all of it. We started in fitness, and we're now going further: a coaching-led health experience that brings together movement, nutrition, sleep and recovery, and leverages real clinical data to build precise, custom member protocols. Our offering is continuing to evolve and we're looking for coaches who want to help shape it.

**About the Role**
------------------

Role Type: 1099 (independent contractor) Full-time

As a Health Coach, you'll own a caseload of members and guide each of them from their first day through their progress milestones. This is a partner role, not a prescriber role: you draw out what a member actually wants, meet them where they are, and help them build habits that last across nutrition, movement, sleep, and stress. You'll coach through a mix of virtual face-to-face sessions and day-to-day messaging, and you'll use each member's data to make your guidance specific and personal. The members we serve expect high-touch, polished care, with the coach at the center of their experience.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Own your members' experience end to end.** Guide a caseload of members from onboarding through their 90-day milestone and beyond, and keep every one of them feeling individually known.
* **Coach live and asynchronously.** Run virtual kickoff and check-in sessions, and support members between sessions over messaging that stays warm, timely, and clear.
* **Build personalized, data-informed plans.** With the support of AI tooling, translate each member's goals and data into a plan across fitness, nutrition, sleep, and recovery, and adjust it as their life and results change.
* **Coach the person, not just the plan.** Use motivational interviewing and reflective listening to help members find their own reasons for change and choose their own next step, rather than handing them a prescription.
* **Make the data useful.** Under the guidance of Future’s Clinical Team, contextualize body composition scans, bloodwork and GLP-1 considerations within your scope, and turn them into everyday actions a member can take.
* **Make progress visible.** Track progress against goals your members helped set, and celebrate the behavior and consistency wins, not just the number on a scan.
* **Help build.** Bring what you learn from members back to the team, and help us shape a program that's ever growing and evolving.

**Who you are**
---------------

* **Empathetic.** You lead with care and meet people where they are, whether it's a member having a hard week or a teammate under pressure.
* **Independent, and collaborative.** You can run your caseload at a high level without hand-holding, and you still genuinely enjoy working alongside your teammates.
* **An active part of the community.** Even though we're a virtual company, you show up: you join calls, contribute to projects, and share honest feedback that makes the team better.
* **Proactive.** You chase down answers, follow up, and take initiative instead of waiting to be told.
* **Tech-savvy.** You pick up new tools quickly and are comfortable working across apps, data, and platforms all day.

**What you'll need**
--------------------

**Required (non-negotiable)**

* **NBC-HWC (National Board Certified Health & Wellness Coach) —** full board certification through the National Board for Health & Wellness Coaching is required. This is our core standard for behavior-change theory, motivational interviewing, reflective listening, and coaching scope of practice.
* **An associate's degree or higher** (or an equivalent, experience-based path to your coaching certification).
* **2+ years of client-facing coaching or training experience.** Enough that you can run a member session on day one, without a ramp.
* **Proven high-volume caseload management.** You've personally carried a large book of clients at once and kept each of them feeling individually known.
* **Comfort working with a diverse member population.** You adapt your style to meet members of different ages, backgrounds, cultures, abilities, and health starting points, and every one of them feels respected and understood.
* **Strong written communication.** Much of your coaching happens over messaging, so you're warm, clear, and personable on the page while staying professional.
* **Strong verbal communication and presence.** You also coach face-to-face over video, and you bring confidence, thoughtfulness and professionalism into every session.
* **Comfortable synthesizing health data.** You keep up with current health trends and have a track record of coaching clients across nutrition apps and wearable devices, bringing their data together into a single comprehensive plan.

**Strong plus (not required)**

* **Additional coaching credentials layered on top of NBC-HWC,** such as ACE Health Coach, Precision Nutrition L1, or NASM Behavior Change Specialist.
* **A personal-training or strength credential** (CSCS; NASM, ACE, or ACSM CPT; or similar).
* **A nutrition-coaching certification** such as Precision Nutrition.
* **An advanced degree** in exercise science, physiology, kinesiology, or a related field.
* **Clinical collaboration in functional or integrative medicine.** You've worked alongside or under registered dietitians, nurse practitioners, or physicians.
